name: 共有元の人物を添えた資料行
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset: targeted correction to LH15-0003 shared-file row, image 2 edit target.
Change ONLY the avatar grouping and surrounding proportions. Image 1 original source controls portrait identity/crop, document glyph, proportions, optical weight and fine detail. Use the exact small existing photo from its shared file row, preserving the real image and its natural original resolution; do not reconstruct, beautify, sharpen, change expression or invent a face. Make avatar and white document badge circles the same small diameter as the original relative to row height, with the original modest overlap. They should be compact like source, not oversized decorative medallions. Keep original blue document artwork and gray shared-person glyph.
Image 3 mock is secondary guide for exact Japanese text. Preserve image2's text exactly: "日曜日の配布資料" / "佐藤さんから共有 · 火曜日", shared glyph before metadata, horizontal three-dot overflow, white rounded surface, fine neutral border, soft shadow and pure white canvas. Do not alter font weights or Japanese wording. Meiryo Regular14/24 and12/16 tracking0 at logical width390. No extra initials, labels, buttons, metrics, rows or page chrome. Source artwork blue retained; utility glyphs slate#526173, text#1D1D1D, metadata#6E6E6E. No mint. Original details override rough mock; no new primary action or gradient. Prioritize literal source portrait preservation over high-resolution facial detail.
reviewNotes: 対象修正を目視確認：人物・資料の円を小さくして原図に近い比例へ改善。日本語・共有アイコン・三点操作を保持。ただし原写真を厳密に保持できず顔は再解釈が残る。2回の生成を保存し、この人物写真の問題は未完了で保留、他の使用可能な部品へ進む。Meiryoの厳密なメトリクス・編集性・実装未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
